exposure: Abuse, disrespect and mistreatment (ADM) during childbirth
abuse, disrespect and mistreatment (ADM) during childbirth care
Women who did and did not report mistreatment
outcome: Perception of abuse during childbirth care
cohort: 745 women from the Ribeirão Preto birth cohorts
finding: While a majority of women experienced at least one situation of ADM during childbirth, only a minority perceived it as disrespect or mistreatment.
